data.answer: This query walks the import graph backwards from auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py, following resolved internal import edges to find every file that imports it directly or transitively, then keeps only non-test files. Each file's path is split to derive its package-directory area from the first two directory levels, and the query counts the distinct importing files per area. Results are ordered by file count descending, then area ascending.

display_annotations.note: Deterministic display links; not source citations made by the model.

output_contract.guidance: Return the package-directory area and file count. Order by files descending, then area ascending.

data.question: Which files import, directly or through other files, auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py? Give the number of such non-test files per directory, using the first two levels of each file's directory.
data.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE importers(file_id) AS (
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py'
  UNION
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  JOIN importers m ON i.imported_file_id = m.file_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN split_part(f.file_id, '/', 3) = '' THEN split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1)
            ELSE split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1) || '/' || split_part(f.file_id, '/', 2) END AS area,
       COUNT(*) AS files
FROM importers m
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = m.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY area
ORDER BY files DESC, area;

request.evidence: Follow resolved imports backwards, recursively. A file's directory is its path without the file name; dev_tools/x.py counts under dev_tools and auto_ontology/dal/x.py under auto_ontology/dal.
request.question:
Which files import, directly or through other files, auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py? Give the number of such non-test files per directory, using the first two levels of each file's directory.

Requested output columns: area (string), files (integer).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
Return the package-directory area and file count. Order by files descending, then area ascending.

data.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reach(file_id) AS (SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports AS i WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py' UNION SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports AS i INNER JOIN reach AS r ON i.imported_file_id = r.file_id), importer_files AS (SELECT f.file_id, string_split(f.file_id, '/') AS parts FROM code.files AS f INNER JOIN reach AS r ON f.file_id = r.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE) SELECT CASE WHEN len(parts) >= 3 THEN parts[1] || '/' || parts[2] WHEN len(parts) = 2 THEN parts[1] ELSE '' END AS area, COUNT(DISTINCT file_id) AS files FROM importer_files GROUP BY area ORDER BY files DESC, area ASC;
